name: Happy Harbor
description: Happy Harbor is the largest watersports company in Orange Beach with two convenient locations. We offer a great atmosphere for families to enjoy water activities with friendly, clean, and fast service. Choose from our huge selection of family fun double-decker pontoons with slides, waverunners, center consoles, kayaks and more. Whether you have a need for speed or would like to cruise on the water for the day, we have it all. Get your happy on at Happy Harbor Marina!
